name: On state change
description: Run code when an entity's state changes (ignores attribute-only changes).

name: On turned on
description: Run code when an entity switches to "on", e.g. a motion sensor.

name: State held for a while
description: Act when an entity stays in a state for a duration, e.g. no motion for 5 minutes. The timer restarts on every change.

name: On custom event
description: React to an event fired on the HA event bus (e.g. from an automation's "event" action) and decode its data.

name: Event program
description: A complete program that reacts to a custom event with a typed payload. Insert into an empty file or in place of main.

name: Fire event
description: Fire a custom event on the HA event bus.

name: Turn on with parameters
description: Call a typed service with parameters.

name: Read state
description: Read a numeric state and an attribute.

name: Every interval
description: Run code periodically. Runs on the handler goroutine, like event handlers.

name: After a delay
description: Run code once after a delay. Runs on the handler goroutine, like event handlers.
